sentences.en: The business will yield a fair return on the investment.
sentences.zh: 这笔生意将为投资带来不错的回报。

sentences.en: I heard that he was very experienced in overseas investments.
sentences.zh: 我听说他在海外投资方面很有经验。

sentences.en: Foreign direct investments in China amounted to $3 billion last year.
sentences.zh: 去年中国吸引的外商直接投资额达到300亿美元。
